title: Supreme Court seeks Bihar response on re-appointment of Deepak Prakash as minister without election
description: The Supreme Court on Monday issued notice on a public interest litigation (PIL) challenging the re-appointment of Deepak Prakash as Bihar's Minister of Panchayati Raj, despite his continued status as an unelected non-legislator [Rakesh Kumar Singh v. State of Bihar].A vacation bench of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justice V Mohana issued the notice before adjourning the matter, as Senior Advocate Vikas Singh, appearing for the petitioner, was not available.
